findings.body: Every new Refused construction omits the required next_step argument, defined in src/forge/repo.py:52. An unverifiable process therefore produces an uncaught TypeError and traceback instead of the promised one-line refusal. The same defect affects worker-only and argument guards, failed termination, and cancellation in machine.py:87,121,219,221,235. The assertions in tests/test_lanes_view.py:194,198,206 still pass because the traceback includes the source line containing the expected message. Supply the required argument at every site and make the command assertions reject tracebacks.
findings.title: Not done: unverifiable process identity refuses with one line

findings.body: The standard requires: "Touch only what the task needs." This change adds configuration-error retries to every Git invocation, and tests/test_close_test_runs_wait_in_line.py:125–137 injects that unrelated failure into the existing close-queue test. Neither change implements core budgeting, lane entries, diagnostics, or cancellation. The handoff names both files and explains the Windows configuration-read failure, but does not establish that the agent-lane change caused it. Move this independent Git reliability repair and its test into a separate fix.
findings.title: Standard: Touch only what the task needs

findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. The retained checker launches Autoreview without process-group options and calls started(pid), as shown in tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533. This stop path requests group termination through src/forge/codex.py:624–625, although that process does not lead its own group. It consequently remains alive and its place cannot be freed. Older Claude workers and readers have the same mismatch. Preserve the ruled compatibility signatures while supporting safe cancellation of these ungrouped processes; the migration test currently launches a newly grouped process.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: The review admission snapshots chosen, but Autoreview defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only selected at src/forge/review.py:570–576. Board JSON therefore continues showing null or the unavailable model during the running review. Split design workers similarly change chosen when falling back to Codex at src/forge/worker.py:167–191 without updating their active entry. Refresh model and effort in the lane entry whenever either caller changes its selection. This previously reported advisory remains unresolved.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual test commands still bypass the shared entries: src/forge/fasttest.py:171–172 launches directly, while close uses the separate ticket queue at src/forge/review.py:279–288. Consequently, the board cannot expose their output or progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:141 assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS

stop.done: src/forge/machine.py is simpler and behaves as it did before
